+# Ponte API governada — inventário Lenovo (Issue #151)
+
+**Data-base:** 14/11/2026. **Escopo:** somente ericson-j-santos/desktop-pc24x7-runtime, main, lenovo-installed-inventory-readonly.yml, DEV.
+
+## Decisão de arquitetura
+
+O workflow existente exige que GitHub actor e triggering_actor sejam ericson-j-santos. Um token de INSTALAÇÃO da GitHub App atuaria como bot e seria recusado. Portanto, esta ponte exige token TEMPORÁRIO de USUÁRIO da GitHub App, obtido via autorização OAuth do proprietário, mantendo a identidade e os gates atuais. **O workflow não foi alterado.**
+
+GitHub App, restrita a um único repositório:
+- Metadata: read (implícito);
+- Contents: read;
+- Actions: write;
+- Variables: write;
+- Administration, Secrets, Contents write, Deployments e Issues write: não conceder.
+
+O token de usuário expira tipicamente em oito horas. O serviço autenticador externo deve cuidar da renovação e rotacionar o refresh token em armazenamento seguro, nunca em código, issues, logs ou artefatos.
+
+## Contrato do script
+
+Arquivo: scripts/lenovo_inventory_api_bridge.py. Dependência usada no CI: cryptography.
+
+Preflight é somente leitura: valida conta autorizada, repositório público, SHA exato da main e um único run de CI push no SHA, com os jobs Windows e Linux concluídos com testes aprovados.
+
+Dispatch exige, adicionalmente:
+1. Ticket assinado com Ed25519 por um autorizador externo autenticado. O ticket tem validade máxima de dez minutos, SHA/usuário/escopo fixos, chave de idempotência e atestado de custo zero com referência de evidência.
+2. A chave PRIVADA de assinatura nunca deve ficar no host da ponte. O host usa somente chave pública em REQSYS_BRIDGE_APPROVER_PUBLIC_KEY (hex). O autorizador deve comprovar a decisão humana atual e a certificação independente de custo; texto de issue, chat copiado e booleano não são prova.
+3. Token temporário de usuário GitHub App em REQSYS_GITHUB_APP_USER_TOKEN, não token de instalação nem PAT permanente.
+4. Arquivo SQLite protegido, persistente e exclusivo de UM executor. Reserva com BEGIN IMMEDIATE e chave única antes de qualquer alteração. Em resultado incerto, o replay é bloqueado; não apagar o estado.
+5. PATCH apenas da variável REQSYS_PC24X7_COST_ZERO_CERTIFIED_SHA, GET de confirmação, nova comparação da main e POST apenas de lenovo-installed-inventory-readonly.yml com inputs fixos, ref main e return_run_details=true.
+6. Validação do workflow_run_id e URL; persistir recibo. A mesma chave retorna o mesmo run_id sem novo POST.
+
+Status retorna metadados de execução e runner, mas **nunca** declara inventário físico provado: faltam recibo autenticado do Command Gateway, SESSION_LAUNCH_OK, SHA instalado e digests verificados de forma independente.
+
+A ponte não altera o PC, não atualiza software, não concede permissão, não faz merge, deploy, limpeza de segredos nem inicia tarefa sem ticket.
+
+## Comandos de referência (NÃO executar antes de concluir a instalação e a autorização)
+
+    python scripts/lenovo_inventory_api_bridge.py preflight --sha <SHA-exato>
+
+    python scripts/lenovo_inventory_api_bridge.py dispatch \
+      --sha <SHA-exato> \
+      --ticket <arquivo-ticket-assinado> \
+      --database <pasta-duravel-protegida>/state.sqlite
+
+    python scripts/lenovo_inventory_api_bridge.py status --sha <SHA-exato> --run-id <ID>
+
+Credenciais somente por variáveis de ambiente carregadas de um cofre seguro, sem digitá-las no chat ou nos comandos.
+
+## Pendências antes da operação
+
+- O autorizador OAuth e emissor do ticket Ed25519 ainda não foram implementados nem instalados. Configuração de App, credenciais, armazenamento e deploy exigem autorização específica e preflight próprio.
+- Custo incremental máximo R$ 0,00. Repositórios públicos têm runners padrão gratuitos conforme documentação GitHub, mas a prova de custo zero aplicável ao DISPATCH, incluindo Billing/Budgets/hard stop quando exigido, é responsabilidade do autorizador independente; não assumir autorização pelo simples fato de o SHA estar no input.
+- O TODO Global não pode ser gravado por esta App sem permissão adicional: resultado deve ser passado ao consumidor governado já autorizado; confirmar readback do TODO, não inferir pela aceitação de evento. Até integração, sincronização pendente.
+- SQLite de um único host não oferece failover físico entre máquinas; não ativar dois executores até existir reserva central atômica e controle de posse.
+- Execução real no DESKTOP-RP23OGS requer autorização própria e gates de identidade, runner, sessão, Gateway, host e prova física.
+
+## Validação
+
+A suíte tests/test_lenovo_inventory_api_bridge.py cobre ticket válido/adulterado/vencido, login/SHA/CI, rejeição de falhas, mudança de main, readback de variável, envio único, replay, resultado HTTP incerto, idempotência e distinção entre API e prova física. Teste isolado não substitui E2E no host.
+
+Fontes oficiais:
+- https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflows
+- https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/variables
+- https://docs.github.com/en/apps/creating-github-apps/authenticating-with-a-github-app/generating-a-user-access-token-for-a-github-app
+- https://docs.github.com/en/actions/concepts/billing-and-usage

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Ponte opt-in para o inventario Lenovo. Nunca faz upgrade nem cria autorizacao.
+
+Exige ticket Ed25519 de um autorizador externo autenticado, token de usuario da
+GitHub App e uma base SQLite duravel de escritor unico. Sem ticket, so preflight.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import base64
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import sqlite3
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from pathlib import Path
+from urllib import error, parse, request
+
+from cryptography.exceptions import InvalidSignature
+from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PublicKey
+
+OWNER = "ericson-j-santos"
+REPO = "desktop-pc24x7-runtime"
+OWNER_ID = 60470500
+WORKFLOW = "lenovo-installed-inventory-readonly.yml"
+VARIABLE = "REQSYS_PC24X7_COST_ZERO_CERTIFIED_SHA"
+CONFIRMATION = "READ_ONLY_LENOVO_INVENTORY"
+BASE = f"/repos/{OWNER}/{REPO}"
+SHA_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{40}\Z")
+HEX_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}\Z")
+
+
+class Blocked(RuntimeError):
+    """Recusa identificada sem expor tokens/segredos."""
+
+
+def canonical(obj: dict) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False,
+                      separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def verify_ticket(document: dict, public_key: bytes, sha: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> dict:
+    """Somente um autorizador externo com chave privada pode gerar o ticket."""
+    now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    if set(document) != {"payload", "signature"} or not isinstance(document["payload"], dict):
+        raise Blocked("approval_envelope_invalid")
+    payload = document["payload"]
+    required = {"request_id", "idempotency_key", "authorized_user_id", "expected_sha",
+                "repository", "workflow", "decision", "issued_at", "expires_at",
+                "cost_zero_certified", "cost_evidence_ref"}
+    if set(payload) != required:
+        raise Blocked("approval_fields_invalid")
+    if (type(payload["authorized_user_id"]) is not int or
+            payload["authorized_user_id"] != OWNER_ID or
+            payload["expected_sha"] != sha or payload["repository"] != f"{OWNER}/{REPO}" or
+            payload["workflow"] != WORKFLOW or
+            payload["decision"] != "authorize_one_readonly_inventory" or
+            payload["cost_zero_certified"] is not True or
+            not isinstance(payload["cost_evidence_ref"], str) or
+            not payload["cost_evidence_ref"].startswith("https://github.com/") or
+            not isinstance(payload["request_id"], str) or
+            not re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{8,80}", payload["request_id"]) or
+            not isinstance(payload["idempotency_key"], str) or
+            not HEX_RE.fullmatch(payload["idempotency_key"])):
+        raise Blocked("approval_contract_rejected")
+    try:
+        issued = datetime.fromisoformat(payload["issued_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        expires = datetime.fromisoformat(payload["expires_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        if (issued.tzinfo is None or expires.tzinfo is None or
+                issued > now or now >= expires or expires - issued > timedelta(minutes=10)):
+            raise Blocked("approval_expired_or_future")
+        signature = base64.b64decode(document["signature"], validate=True)
+        Ed25519PublicKey.from_public_bytes(public_key).verify(signature, canonical(payload))
+    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, InvalidSignature) as exc:
+        raise Blocked("approval_signature_or_time_invalid") from exc
+    return payload
+
+
+class NoRedirect(request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
+    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
+        raise Blocked("api_redirect_forbidden")
+
+
+class Api:
+    """API oficial com host fixo, sem redirecionamentos arbitrarios."""
+
+    def __init__(self, token: str):
+        if not token.startswith("ghu_") or len(token) < 20:
+            raise Blocked("github_app_user_token_required")
+        self.token = token
+
+    def call(self, method: str, path: str, data: dict | None = None) -> dict:
+        if not path.startswith("/") or ".." in path or "//" in path:
+            raise Blocked("api_path_invalid")
+        body = canonical(data) if data is not None else None
+        req = request.Request(
+            "https://api.github.com" + path, data=body, method=method,
+            headers={"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
+                     "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2026-03-10",
+                     "Authorization": "Bearer " + self.token,
+                     "Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "reqsys-lenovo-bridge/1"})
+        try:
+            with request.build_opener(NoRedirect()).open(req, timeout=15) as response:
+                raw = response.read(2_000_000)
+                if response.status not in (200, 201, 204) or response.url.split("/", 3)[2] != "api.github.com":
+                    raise Blocked("api_response_untrusted")
+                return json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
+        except (error.HTTPError, error.URLError, TimeoutError, ValueError) as exc:
+            # Nao propagar corpo de erro, headers ou token.
+            raise Blocked("github_api_unavailable_or_denied") from None
+
+
+def assert_owner_and_main(api: Api, sha: str) -> None:
+    user = api.call("GET", "/user")
+    if user.get("login") != OWNER or user.get("id") != OWNER_ID:
+        raise Blocked("owner_oauth_identity_mismatch")
+    repo = api.call("GET", BASE)
+    if repo.get("full_name") != f"{OWNER}/{REPO}" or repo.get("private") is not False:
+        raise Blocked("repository_not_public_or_mismatch")
+    branch = api.call("GET", BASE + "/branches/main")
+    if branch.get("commit", {}).get("sha") != sha:
+        raise Blocked("main_sha_moved")
+
+
+def assert_ci(api: Api, sha: str) -> int:
+    query = parse.urlencode({"branch": "main", "head_sha": sha, "event": "push",
+                             "status": "completed", "per_page": 100})
+    runs = api.call("GET", BASE + "/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?" + query)
+    if runs.get("total_count") != 1 or len(runs.get("workflow_runs", [])) != 1:
+        raise Blocked("ci_run_not_unique")
+    run = runs["workflow_runs"][0]
+    if (run.get("head_sha") != sha or run.get("head_branch") != "main" or
+            run.get("event") != "push" or run.get("status") != "completed" or
+            run.get("conclusion") != "success" or run.get("run_attempt") != 1):
+        raise Blocked("ci_not_approved")
+    jobs = api.call("GET", BASE + f"/actions/runs/{run['id']}/jobs?per_page=100")
+    if jobs.get("total_count") != len(jobs.get("jobs", [])):
+        raise Blocked("ci_jobs_incomplete")
+    for name, label in (("Python compile and tests", "windows-latest"),
+                        ("Portable Linux compile and tests", "ubuntu-latest")):
+        matches = [j for j in jobs["jobs"] if j.get("name") == name]
+        if len(matches) != 1 or matches[0].get("status") != "completed" or matches[0].get("conclusion") != "success" or label not in matches[0].get("labels", []) or not any(
+                s.get("name") == "Unit and negative-control tests" and
+                s.get("conclusion") == "success" and s.get("status") == "completed"
+                for s in matches[0].get("steps", [])):
+            raise Blocked("ci_required_job_not_approved")
+    return run["id"]
+
+
+def reserve(connection: sqlite3.Connection, key: str, sha: str, request_id: str) -> dict | None:
+    """Reserva antes de qualquer POST. Replay incompleto nao causa novo dispatch."""
+    connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+    row = connection.execute("SELECT sha, request_id, state, run_id FROM dispatches WHERE idempotency_key=?", (key,)).fetchone()
+    if row:
+        connection.commit()
+        if row[0] != sha or row[1] != request_id:
+            raise Blocked("idempotency_key_reused_for_different_request")
+        if row[2] == "dispatched":
+            return {"result": "REPLAY_SAME_RUN", "run_id": row[3], "sha": sha}
+        raise Blocked("reserved_or_unknown_outcome_needs_reconciliation")
+    connection.execute("INSERT INTO dispatches VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",
+                       (key, sha, request_id, "reserved", None))
+    connection.commit()
+    return None
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def database(path: Path):
+    """Fecha a conexao no Windows e POSIX mesmo quando a operacao falha."""
+    if not path.is_absolute() or not path.parent.is_dir() or path.is_symlink():
+        raise Blocked("durable_state_directory_invalid")
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(path, timeout=1, isolation_level=None)
+    try:
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
+        conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dispatches (idempotency_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sha TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, run_id INTEGER)")
+        yield conn
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+
+
+def execute(api: Api, db: sqlite3.Connection, ticket: dict, sha: str) -> dict:
+    """Apenas um disparo. Em resultado HTTP incerto, reserva impede replay cego."""
+    assert_owner_and_main(api, sha)
+    ci_run_id = assert_ci(api, sha)
+    replay = reserve(db, ticket["idempotency_key"], sha, ticket["request_id"])
+    if replay:
+        return replay
+    # Mesmo depois da reserva, revalidar main antes de alterar variavel.
+    assert_owner_and_main(api, sha)
+    varpath = BASE + "/actions/variables/" + VARIABLE
+    previous = api.call("GET", varpath)
+    if previous.get("name") != VARIABLE:
+        raise Blocked("certification_variable_missing")
+    api.call("PATCH", varpath, {"name": VARIABLE, "value": sha})
+    readback = api.call("GET", varpath)
+    if readback.get("name") != VARIABLE or readback.get("value") != sha:
+        raise Blocked("certification_readback_failed")
+    assert_owner_and_main(api, sha)
+    dispatch = api.call("POST", BASE + f"/actions/workflows/{WORKFLOW}/dispatches",
+                        {"ref": "main", "return_run_details": True,
+                         "inputs": {"expected_source_sha": sha, "confirmation": CONFIRMATION}})
+    run_id = dispatch.get("workflow_run_id")
+    if type(run_id) is not int or run_id <= 0 or dispatch.get("html_url") != (
+            f"https://github.com/{OWNER}/{REPO}/actions/runs/{run_id}"):
+        raise Blocked("dispatch_result_ambiguous_no_retry")
+    db.execute("UPDATE dispatches SET state='dispatched', run_id=? WHERE idempotency_key=? AND state='reserved'",
+               (run_id, ticket["idempotency_key"]))
+    return {"result": "DISPATCH_CREATED_NOT_YET_VALIDATED", "run_id": run_id,
+            "sha": sha, "ci_run_id": ci_run_id, "request_id": ticket["request_id"]}
+
+
+def readback(api: Api, run_id: int, sha: str) -> dict:
+    """Nao confundir status success com recibo fisico autenticado."""
+    run = api.call("GET", BASE + f"/actions/runs/{run_id}")
+    if (run.get("id") != run_id or run.get("head_sha") != sha or
+            run.get("event") != "workflow_dispatch" or run.get("head_branch") != "main" or
+            run.get("actor", {}).get("login") != OWNER):
+        raise Blocked("run_identity_mismatch")
+    jobs = api.call("GET", BASE + f"/actions/runs/{run_id}/jobs?per_page=100")
+    if jobs.get("total_count") != len(jobs.get("jobs", [])):
+        raise Blocked("run_jobs_incomplete")
+    inv = [x for x in jobs["jobs"] if x.get("name") == "inventory"]
+    if len(inv) != 1:
+        raise Blocked("inventory_job_not_unique")
+    job = inv[0]
+    return {"result": "RUN_METADATA_ONLY_PHYSICAL_RECEIPT_PENDING",
+            "run_id": run_id, "sha": sha,
+            "status": run.get("status"), "conclusion": run.get("conclusion"),
+            "job_status": job.get("status"), "job_conclusion": job.get("conclusion"),
+            "runner_name": job.get("runner_name"), "runner_id": job.get("runner_id"),
+            "physical_receipt_proven": False}
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Ponte Lenovo governada, sem upgrade")
+    parser.add_argument("action", choices=("preflight", "dispatch", "status"))
+    parser.add_argument("--sha", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--ticket")
+    parser.add_argument("--database")
+    parser.add_argument("--run-id", type=int)
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    if not SHA_RE.fullmatch(args.sha):
+        print(json.dumps({"result": "BLOCKED", "reason": "sha_invalid"}))
+        return 3
+    try:
+        api = Api(os.environ.get("REQSYS_GITHUB_APP_USER_TOKEN", ""))
+        if args.action == "preflight":
+            assert_owner_and_main(api, args.sha)
+            ci = assert_ci(api, args.sha)
+            output = {"result": "GITHUB_READONLY_PREFLIGHT_OK_NOT_AUTHORIZED", "sha": args.sha, "ci_run_id": ci}
+        elif args.action == "status":
+            if args.run_id is None or args.run_id <= 0:
+                raise Blocked("run_id_required")
+            output = readback(api, args.run_id, args.sha)
+        else:
+            if not args.ticket or not args.database:
+                raise Blocked("signed_ticket_and_durable_database_required")
+            public = bytes.fromhex(os.environ.get("REQSYS_BRIDGE_APPROVER_PUBLIC_KEY", ""))
+            ticket = verify_ticket(json.loads(Path(args.ticket).read_text(encoding="utf-8")), public, args.sha)
+            with database(Path(args.database)) as db:
+                output = execute(api, db, ticket, args.sha)
+        print(json.dumps(output, sort_keys=True))
+        return 0
+    except (Blocked, OSError, ValueError, sqlite3.Error) as exc:
+        reason = str(exc) if isinstance(exc, Blocked) else "dependency_unavailable"
+        print(json.dumps({"result": "BLOCKED", "reason": reason}, sort_keys=True))
+        return 3
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""SQLite local: disputa de chave e retomada. Nao valida failover entre PCs."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import sqlite3
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+from pathlib import Path
+from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
+from threading import Barrier
+
+SOURCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts' / 'lenovo_inventory_api_bridge.py'
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('lenovo_bridge_concurrency', SOURCE)
+bridge = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+assert spec.loader
+spec.loader.exec_module(bridge)
+SHA = 'b038a770117e0d3d4d1297a3f4bec112ff68a744'
+KEY = 'a' * 64
+
+
+def test_two_independent_connections_reserve_once():
+    gate = Barrier(2)
+    with TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        dbpath = Path(tmp) / 'state.sqlite'
+
+        def worker():
+            with bridge.database(dbpath) as db:
+                gate.wait(timeout=5)
+                try:
+                    return bridge.reserve(db, KEY, SHA, 'same-approved-request')
+                except bridge.Blocked as exc:
+                    return str(exc)
+
+        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
+            f1 = executor.submit(worker)
+            f2 = executor.submit(worker)
+            results = [f1.result(timeout=10), f2.result(timeout=10)]
+        assert sum(x is None for x in results) == 1
+        assert results.count('reserved_or_unknown_outcome_needs_reconciliation') == 1
+        with bridge.database(dbpath) as db:
+            assert db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatches').fetchone()[0] == 1
+
+
+def test_crash_reopen_fails_closed_and_never_forgets_key():
+    with TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        dbpath = Path(tmp) / 'state.sqlite'
+        with bridge.database(dbpath) as db:
+            assert bridge.reserve(db, KEY, SHA, 'approved-request') is None
+        with bridge.database(dbpath) as db:
+            try:
+                bridge.reserve(db, KEY, SHA, 'approved-request')
+            except bridge.Blocked as exc:
+                assert str(exc) == 'reserved_or_unknown_outcome_needs_reconciliation'
+            else:
+                raise AssertionError('replay_did_not_block')
+            assert db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatches').fetchone()[0] == 1
+
+
+def test_connection_is_explicitly_closed_after_context():
+    """A transacao commitada nao basta: no Windows, o handle precisa fechar."""
+    with TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        path = Path(tmp) / 'state.sqlite'
+        with bridge.database(path) as db:
+            bridge.reserve(db, KEY, SHA, 'approved-request')
+        try:
+            db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatches')
+        except sqlite3.ProgrammingError:
+            pass
+        else:
+            raise AssertionError('sqlite_connection_was_not_closed')
+        with bridge.database(path) as db2:
+            assert db2.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatches').fetchone()[0] == 1

+

+        "decision": "authorize_one_readonly_inventory",
+        "issued_at": (now - timedelta(seconds=3)).isoformat(),
+        "expires_at": (now + timedelta(minutes=4)).isoformat(),
+        "cost_zero_certified": True,
+        "cost_evidence_ref": "https://github.com/ericson-j-santos/desktop-pc24x7-runtime/issues/151",
+    }
+    payload.update(update)
+    private = Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
+    signature = private.sign(bridge.canonical(payload))
+    document = {"payload": payload, "signature": base64.b64encode(signature).decode("ascii")}
+    public = private.public_key().public_bytes_raw()
+    return document, public

+def job(name, label):

+class FakeApi:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.head = SHA
+        self.var = "old" * 13 + "o"
+        self.runs = [{"id": 88, "head_sha": SHA, "head_branch": "main", "event": "push",
+                      "status": "completed", "conclusion": "success", "run_attempt": 1}]
+        self.jobs = [job("Python compile and tests", "windows-latest"),
+                     job("Portable Linux compile and tests", "ubuntu-latest")]
+        self.post_count = 0
+        self.calls = []
+        self.dispatch_response = {
+            "workflow_run_id": RUN_ID,
+            "html_url": f"https://github.com/{bridge.OWNER}/{bridge.REPO}/actions/runs/{RUN_ID}"}
+        self.run_metadata = {"id": RUN_ID, "head_sha": SHA,
+                             "event": "workflow_dispatch", "head_branch": "main",
+                             "status": "completed", "conclusion": "success",
+                             "actor": {"login": bridge.OWNER}}
+
+    def call(self, method, path, data=None):
+        self.calls.append((method, path, data))
+        if path == "/user":
+            return {"login": bridge.OWNER, "id": bridge.OWNER_ID}
+        if path == bridge.BASE:
+            return {"full_name": f"{bridge.OWNER}/{bridge.REPO}", "private": False}
+        if path == bridge.BASE + "/branches/main":
+            return {"commit": {"sha": self.head}}
+        if "/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?" in path:
+            return {"total_count": len(self.runs), "workflow_runs": self.runs}
+        if path == bridge.BASE + "/actions/runs/88/jobs?per_page=100":
+            return {"total_count": len(self.jobs), "jobs": self.jobs}
+        if path == bridge.BASE + "/actions/variables/" + bridge.VARIABLE:
+            if method == "PATCH":
+                self.var = data["value"]
+                return {}
+            return {"name": bridge.VARIABLE, "value": self.var}
+        if path == bridge.BASE + f"/actions/workflows/{bridge.WORKFLOW}/dispatches":
+            assert method == "POST"
+            assert data == {"ref": "main", "return_run_details": True,
+                            "inputs": {"expected_source_sha": SHA,
+                                       "confirmation": bridge.CONFIRMATION}}
+            self.post_count += 1
+            return self.dispatch_response
+        if path == bridge.BASE + f"/actions/runs/{RUN_ID}":
+            return self.run_metadata
+        if path == bridge.BASE + f"/actions/runs/{RUN_ID}/jobs?per_page=100":
+            return {"total_count": 1, "jobs": [{"name": "inventory", "status": "completed",
+                                                  "conclusion": "success", "runner_name": "DESKTOP-RP23OGS-runtime",
+                                                  "runner_id": 9}]}
+        raise AssertionError(f"unexpected API: {method}, {path}")
